newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: EBRD gives Azeris $21.65 million power sector loan.
newsitem.headline: EBRD gives Azeris $21.65 million power sector loan.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has granted a sovereign-guaranteed loan of $21.65 million to Azerbaijan's power sector, the cabinet said on Wednesday.
A spokesman said the credit would be used to finance energy equipment, including the replacement of three generators at the Mingyachevir Hydropower Plant.
"The credit was allocated for 15 years with annual seven percent interest rate and has a four year grace period," he said.
